description: Look up the destinations a connected account can publish into — Discord or Slack channels, Pinterest boards, Reddit post flairs, Hashnode or Medium publications, Hashnode tags, Lemmy communities, Listmonk lists or templates, Skool groups, Whop forums, or WordPress categories and tags. Use the returned ids in schedule_post's platform_meta. Reads live from the platform, so an empty list can also mean the platform could not be reached.

kind.description: Which list to fetch; it must match the connected account's platform.

subreddit.description: Subreddit name (without r/). Required for kind=reddit_flairs.

name: list_publish_options
